author: TheMasterCow
body:
(title of image looks crooked, it's not, it's the font).
Rezonate is a DTM TNT map by ParaSpider and Trans4rm2me. Admiral Para and Admiral Trans have been in war for years and they have decided to settle it with battle. the 2 battleships have met and they are ready to attack and destroy the opposing team's Reactors. Taking place in the Rezonate sea, who will be left afloat?

Teams:
Poly (Red)
Para (Blue)

Features:
TNT, Let the war begin.

Authors:
- ParaSpider
- Trans4rm2me

Download
Images
YAML

Also... can you guess why I named it "Rezonate" sea? :3
